content.value: A factory has 200 machines and the maintenance engineer supervises the repair crews who (08) repair malfunctioning machines. The maintenance policy is to repair the broken down machine and bring back in production within two hours on the average. If average breakdown rate is 3.5 machine/hour and each repair crew can repair 0.25 machine/hour on the average. How many repair crews are rcquired?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
